chapters: Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ cham jix jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat tu' juruuñ gu bhóogɨt u'ua'tulhdhix tu' daakat.
Jano' ba' va'k ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu u'u gu ux na tu ibai' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook jajar cham gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham tomaat; gu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix búup tomaat ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' u'ua'tulhdhix gu ñi'ook jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix maati' gu bhóogɨt jir bhai' ja'tkam; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'm gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch.
Na jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook i'iich gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx daak.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Sioon gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu mar tu'; jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu maa'nkar chɨbɨɨp gu maa'nkar gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix ko'k duu bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' na ja'p vaaso jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Serbid gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx choo'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk i'iich; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk vupui bhaan gu Absalom gu mar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mui'x bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' mui'x tu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kutun kavɨk xikoolh tu'; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' mo'o.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' dɨr gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' bɨx; jano' ba' tomaat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' bhaan gu ja'tkam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Neginot; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai'; gio ba' kua' tu'; mi' dhɨr mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' soi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhat gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook tui'ka' gu ñi'ook gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba'; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' duuñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Opreked makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mui'x tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Alsa bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak bhai' ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' gu ñi'ook kai'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Neilot; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu xibh tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' cham bhai' cham ju'ñdharan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham no'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ iatda' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ba'k gu vaak; gio ba' bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' choo'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' kuiñcha; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ba'k gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr tukga'n jix kupi'ook; jano' ba' bɨɨx nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' gu Desbaraatalos gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx tu'; na gu' na ba' bɨɨx tas jiiñak na gu' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai'; gio ba' mia'n na ja'p bɨɨx kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Neginot bhaan gu Seminit; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham i'iich tu' bɨɨx daak.
Na gu' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' o'oo.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm duuk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Na gu' na gu' koi'm cham cham tu'x jai'ch chɨ'ñchoka' tu'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tukga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu tukaa' dhim dhaibu' bɨɨx suakɨt.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' kuiñcha bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak gu ñi'ook suanda'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak soi'ñ; gio ba' tu' dho'ñchidhak gu Jawatan Dios soi'm.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' bɨx; gio ba' tu jiim ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' gu Sigaioon gu Dabii jiiñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Kus gu mar gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ maavɨt cham ka't namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu noobh tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm cham kuiñcha ka't bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaamki'ñdha' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu oidha' nɨidhat jix duñia' oo'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx i'iich; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' xoi'kam jix búup jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai' jurtu'nka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' jir bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' kutun kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jir bhai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan cham bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook juraa'n tu' u'u gat tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook koi'm; gio ba' tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' oidha' suudai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duu.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Altiisimo.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Gittit; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan chulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' bhaan gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk kuiñcha na ba' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr tu duukam gu masad gu si'avag tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chio'ñ na ba' chɨ'ñchoka' gu mar gu chio'ñ.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' daada' gu jodai' na jix uam gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi gu noobh; gio ba' bɨx bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' kakneer gu vaakax bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Mut-labben; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Altiisimo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' kuiñcha; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp cham bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas mɨɨjidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh chɨ'ñchoka' bɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' atooxkor na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oipichu' bɨɨx bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam buimɨi.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr tɨ'ñcho; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook bia'.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kiki'ñgob koi'm.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook kiki'ñgob mar u'vɨ gu Sioon tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp jix duu; gio ba' jix vɨgɨ ka't jix duñia' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' tu duukam gu noobh ka't cham bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu igaion; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' tomaat ka't bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' cham na ba' bɨɨx tas ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gampai'; gio ba' tu' nɨɨra bia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr ka't chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios choo'n; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp cham gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñ.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gampai'; gio ba' ka't jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu vupui cham tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' juraa'n gu bhóogɨt ñiata; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chin bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham jix duñia' joi'mdak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' mɨɨjidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhuup gu chin mu'ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨtaa'n nɨɨn gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taañpu'; gio ba' mu'aa; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gampai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p maavɨt dɨr; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' gampai'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gampai' jix vɨgɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na jix kavɨk mui'x jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' dhix gu vupui; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buupui; na gu' tu' tu jiim na ba' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr tu' gampai' tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx ka'm matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ naak.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gampai' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu u'uvhig.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat gu ñi'ook bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai'; gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bhaamki'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan tomaat gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tai choiñ bɨɨx jɨbɨɨlh ka't.
Na gu' na gu' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Seminit; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; na gu' dodhia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jix bɨɨx duu i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook maa'n bɨɨx tɨtmo; gio ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook nɨɨn tu ñi'ook.
Na gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch; jano' ba' chɨkka gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bia' jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix toja jodai gu oidha' kɨɨv mui'kim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x na ba' bɨɨx tas bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu vupui tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm duuk ka't bhaamki'ñdha' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' gu vupui na gu' cham koi'm.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaamki'ñdha' gu Benkiilo; gio ba' tu'.
Gu' gu' tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ tulhiiñdha'.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu buimɨi; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim dɨr gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨma'n jix duñia'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' machia' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai' jix duñia' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios nɨɨra.
Jano' ba' chɨkka koi gu Sioon tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Jakob gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chɨkka gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Na jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx bhai' tu ñi'ook tu'r gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu vupui jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' nɨidhat gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr dhaibu gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai' cham gu ñi'ook.
Na tuumiñ cham jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan jix bhɨɨ; na duñia' dhi' tu'x cham na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Miktam gu Dabii; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' cham.
Gu' gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n vaaso; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ia'rɨ gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu maa'nkar tu' dhaa.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' kɨɨ'n cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' gio gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' cham kiicha' gu i'ii'ñ tukga'n; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ja'bsuna'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bɨɨx gu vupui; mi' dhɨr jix bhai' kɨɨ'n na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' soi'm gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix kai soi'm cham gu ñi'ook iatda'.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham tu' bakia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chin cham tu'.
Na ba' na ba' buimɨi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na gu' tɨɨt cham.
Na gu' gu Yo tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' naak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix tuk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ɨkgiga'n.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan tomaat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ mia'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨɨx gu chin tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' mia'n jano'; gio ba' namki' gu vupui na ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ cham bhai' bɨɨx gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ oipichu' baasɨ'n dhi' gu oidha' vook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chumñigam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Yo bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk na jax chu'm.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Salmo gu Dabii tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' bhai' ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr kutun kavɨk tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm bhi'ñbak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tukga'n jix duñia' koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook dɨr vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu kakkavɨk na gu'.
Jano' ba' kuubh jix tɨ'ɨ daak gu chin jix duñia' gu tai; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav; gio ba' gu tukgam bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan juu'ñdham tɨkɨr da'a; gio ba' da'a bhaan gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tukgam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu tukgam gu suudai' tɨbaa'ñ gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tɨbaa'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Altiisimo jix maa gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' oipichu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu jɨvɨl daak.
Jano' ba' bhañ dɨr jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jix buusñi mumua'da' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' jix duñia' jix kavɨk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu noobh tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' bɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' cham tu' ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx bhai' na ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu noobh vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' na jix bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx jix bhai'x ka' na ba' bɨɨx jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' u'ua'tɨda' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam.
Na gu' na gu' bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chugi'ñ; gio ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr kutun kavɨk bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch mai' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk mai' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' tɨɨt na ja'p tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh na ba' ka't bɨɨx u'u gat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kutun kavɨk tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' kɨɨ'n tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n tu' cham kɨkbok.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix búup; gio ba' ia'rɨ bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk na ba'; gio ba' bɨtaa'n tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham ka't dodhia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu' cham jix kai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p oo' vupui bhaan gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu' cham.
Na ba' ka't naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ dɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tai gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai kavɨk; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch Xoi'kam gu Dabii gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu tɨkɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook matda'.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' jix buus oipichu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix dhaas vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan na ba' gu tas.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix tónom.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' chuut gu Jawatan Dios jix maat jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios na jix bhai' pataasa' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu'r bɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix jai' jix uam jodai; gio ba' suudai' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' nukadham cham tu'x jai'ch jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' maakam chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Liibrame.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; na cham tu'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx bhai' dhi' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu chin gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'ua'tɨdham dɨr xidhuu dɨr gu Sioon tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' bɨx maatai maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' gu tɨɨgɨ' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham Xoi'kam; gio ba' dɨr gu tɨkɨr jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu kavɨk u'ua'tɨdham kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gu' no'ch gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chɨ'ñchoka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ia'rɨ; gu' no'ch.
Jano' ba' dodhia' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tulhiiñdha' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ chɨɨdak cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx xoi'kam; gio ba' kuruun jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ' gɇ'kamtu'nda' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' nɨidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vupui.
Na gu' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Altiisimo cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨx; gio ba' kɨɨ'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu ñi'ook daak; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios i'iich gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu i'bhɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu kai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu' cham.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Ajelet-saar; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tɨtda:―Cha'pim tulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu tanoolh cham; gio ba' gu tukaa' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' tu' duiñ.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhai' ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Gu' gu' tu' jix duñia' suulhgidha' cham gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' mo'o bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buusñi vook bhaan dɨr ka't gu naan.
Jano' ba' bhaan tu' jix duñia' baas dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dɨr vook gu naan tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na gu' mia'n; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia'.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'iix jix kavɨk; gio ba' jix duñia' cham kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' xoi'kam tu' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tulhiiñdha'.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Jedutuun; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Dije; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na ba' cham bɨɨx nɨɨn; gio ba' gu chin bɨɨx cham bhai' ja'tkam ua'tulhi'ñ bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx duiñ jix bhai'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu tai bɨɨx nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maachim gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu' no'ñ oipichu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨɨdak gu tanoolh gu oidha' jix bhai'x na ja'p cham tu' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tukgam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham chɨkka.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨra tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu chin; na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; gio ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu novɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan uañi'ñ gu chio'ñ na ja'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham suakɨt; na gu' jix duñia' na ba' bɨndak na ja'p bɨx tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' na jix kavɨk va'k.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix kai tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix dhaas tɨɨt bhaan jodai kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' mui'x gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhai' ñi'ook gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chotdonɨt cham tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨ'p; gio ba' na ba' bɨɨx no'ch cham tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook cham jɨ'xdha'.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'; gio ba' jix kupi'ook maatɨt; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan cham tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr u'uan ua'nak tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aagak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ ba'k.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx bhai' jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan Dios tu' ñɨidhat.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu'r u'ua'tɨdham tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r jix duñia' bɨɨx tas.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' mia'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm cham; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham ñiata; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' kuupa'n mo'o gu i'ii'ñ uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu oidha' na ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨɨx tas tulhiiñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu'; gio ba' u'ua'tɨdham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr bhai' ñi'ook gampai'; na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu oidha' cham kapbhai' aagak.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhim; gio ba' bɨx ko'kdai'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; na gu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na gu' bhaan tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu'; gio ba' duuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhimɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mai' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai bhaan tu' bɨx; gio ba' bhaan tu' cham bhai' bham tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Maskuil gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' duuñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu suakɨt gu takarui' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan tu' gu i'ii'ñ; na pai' dhuuk jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tu jiim bɨɨx bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu Espera gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' no'ñ tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu'; gio ba' tu' dɨr gu oidha' gu Jordaan gu ermonitas dɨr gu kavɨk gu Misar.
Jano' ba' jix dhaam suudai' mɨmɨim gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu tukaa' ka't soi'm gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Roka tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' gu Por tu jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam o'oo obhɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu Espera gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' no'ñ; mi' dhɨr dodhia' vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ iatda' tu' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tasi' tu'r; gio ba' jix duñia' gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ba'k jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios bhai' ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu Espera gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dodhia' vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu Maskuil; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatɨt naak tattat jix duñia' tu duukam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu ux na tu ibai'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu kuchii tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu vupui na gu' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u gat tu' gu kuchii u'ua'tɨda'.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tas na jix gɨ' bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaamki'ñdha' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kakneer na ba' jugi tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xi'ɨraam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp mo'o gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh xi'ɨraam vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' tu' tɨbiap cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'; gio ba' cham ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' bɨɨx ɨkgiga'n koi'm.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tɨɨgɨ' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Matan gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu'ch na ja'p kakneer na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Despierta cham tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm oo'; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' vook bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bamii' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Sosannim; na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; jano' ba' gu Maskuil; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhai'; jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' buimɨi; gio ba' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' nɨidhidha' ja'aa; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii bhaan gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk bɨɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook tu'r cha'pim bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr kɨɨ'n tu' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' atooxkor gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' bɨx bhai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' tu' na cham jir bhai'; na ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu gɨ'kora' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨɨ'n bɨɨx jix uam jodai gu Opir.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ tu' naak; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' na gu' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Tiro aajim bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chutumñigam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu jodai' na jix uam jix uam jodai tɨi'chu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jajannulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr ka't tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' jɨjɨkgɨm gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' pai' tattat ka't gu ma'nkam jix duu chiñia' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu ma'nkam; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Alamot; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu kavɨk chulhiiñdha' bopxi'ñ.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu oidha' ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'; gio ba' gu kakkavɨk kuiñcha gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Jawatan Dios xidhuu vaak zel gu Altiisimo.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na u'u gat u'u kavɨk gu tai.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu noobh; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Altiisimo gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix gɨ' bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n no'ch chɨbɨɨp bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt dɨppɨr; gio ba' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix bhaan atooxkor.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ja'tkam jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n kiicham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' gɨ' bɨx gu oidha' gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' jum daa'ñ; gio ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Tarsis.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buupui kiicham gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ kiicham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Sioon; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Judaa ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh gu Sioon; gio ba' gɨ' vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook; na ba'.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx; jano' ba' bɨx oipichu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gampai' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' gu chin tu ñi'ook matda'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' na cham jir bhai' mia'n.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkɨm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' u'uuk cham mɨɨjidha'; gio ba'.
Na gu tai jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' tu' kuusdaidha' mamatdagɨm na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkɨm.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x namki' gu vaak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'; gio ba'.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhat; gio ba' nɨidhim gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' koi'm; mi' dhɨr gu xibh; jano' ba' xoi'kam tukga'n gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk cham jum i'obh na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' na pai' dhuuk gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu vaak.
Na gu' na gu' vaak jodai cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' tu' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' tu' xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; na pai' dhuuk tu' ka' na pai' dhuuk xoi'kam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat; gio ba' cham gu tasi' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhim gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asap; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu oidha' dɨr gu tas bɨɨx ka'm pai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tai vupui bhaan jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr jiix gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨgi'ñdham; na jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Israeel bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak ali' vaakax tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ɨɨr.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' kakasnira' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhiogi' cham tu'; na gu' oipichu'.
Jano' ba' no'ñ jugi tu' gu chuukug tutuur i'i gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ɨɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Sakripika gu Jawatan Dios bhai' ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Altiisimo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu' nɨidhat.
Ba' jix aa' gu' cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chin.
Na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook sɨlhka'n jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨxkum tu' bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨɨx ka't baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' nɨɨn iatda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan xibhɨk; gio ba' bhaan gu mar gu naan gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tɨɨda' tu' na ja'p tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't cham soo'mchulhdhak namkidhat.
Na gu vaak na jix bhai' bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui gu Batseba suudai' u'va gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr mambhɨɨx jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; jano' ba' jurtu'nka' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' uañi'ñ bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' jir bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu'r; gio ba' ɨxchuixim gu ñi'ook matda'.
Jano' ba' gu Puripiikame bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jabook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' o'oo jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui uañi'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Krea tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham tu' jix bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' u'ua'tulhdhix tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' nɨɨn bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chin bhai' ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu maa'nkar tu'; gio ba' cham maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon; gio ba' vaak jodai gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨx bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' gu maa'nkar bɨx vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' jano' ba' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ali' vaakax.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk gu Maskuil gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va gu Doeg gu Idumeo jix maa jix duñia' gu Sauul tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii tu' tɨbiap gu vaak gu Aimelek; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn; gio ba' na ja'p iatda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' xoi'kam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñiokda' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' dha' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai' nɨɨn.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' gu oidha' na jix do'ig; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' ja'tkam; gio ba' bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ cham jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook namkɨm tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Gu' gu' tu' dhi' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' jix bhai' vupui bhaan jɨɨgi'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Maalat; mi' dhɨr gu Maskuil gu Dabii; jano' ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu tu' na cham jir bhai'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' cham namki' machia' bɨx jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' kua'da' gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' daam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' cham ka't ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' o'oo yooxi' bhaan tu'; na gu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chɨkka koi gu Sioon tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam tu' gu Jakob gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Neginot; na pai' dhuuk gu Maskuil gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu Sipeos gui'p gu Sauul; jano' ba' cham gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm; gio ba' gu chin.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai'; gio ba' tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan tu'; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jix bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Neginot; mi' dhɨr gu Maskuil gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios soi'm cham tu' ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook soi'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham bhai' ja'tkam; na gu' bhaan tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx i'iich jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook koi'm bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' choo'n gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' tɨɨtɨs bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhaan dhaas.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gioda' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan nɨɨn; na gu' buupui gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan vaak jodai; gio ba' tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu jiim cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ iatda' cham jix bhai'x.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaamki'ñdha'; na gu' tu' bhaan tu' na gu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Na tɨtda:―Aañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chu'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't koi'm jix duñia' ko'iix; na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch chu'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios duuñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨda'.
Jano' ba' gu xumai gu xibh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duuñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu i'ii'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan tu'; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan tu' mui'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu ñi'ook pataasa' gu Sela; na gu' cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu' bhɨɨ'ñdham cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' gu'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham kiicha' na ba' bɨɨx tas jir bhai'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' suudai'; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ cham gu tanoolh; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gioda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk gu Pilisteos gu Gat; na gu' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; na gu' mui'x bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Altiisimo.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan tu' bɨx na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨrda' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios i'iich gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' suakɨt; mi' dhɨr cham u'uan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh tu' duuñ; gio ba' dhi' kakasnira' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bopxi'ñ bhai' ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' koi'm tɨɨt na ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk vupui bhaan gu Sauul jumpa'n; jano' ba' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; na gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ ɨkgiga'n bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Altiisimo gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr u'ua'tɨda' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Sela; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr u'u kavɨk nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' jix vɨgɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx ka'm tɨbaa'ñ tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Miktam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu'r bɨx bhai' gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' va'k bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' xoi'kam jix duu gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr; gio ba' dɨr vook a'gi'ñchu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' nɨidhim gu ko'oi; gio ba' na ja'p jix bhai'x naak.
Na cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't bapaalh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p gu u'vɨ cham gu tas.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jo'ii' ko'iix bɨɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'; gio ba' tɨɨt gu ɨ'ɨr cham bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'bhɨ na ba' jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk bhañ gu Sauul nukadham gu vaak na ba' kooda'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu chichio'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix kavɨk cham uañi'ñ tu' uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ba'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨx bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu xumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kiicham.

Na gu' cham koo'nda' na gu' gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu jiim bɨɨx gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu chin gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't ui'ka' mu'ai gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu xumai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' tu' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Yo cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; na gu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Susan-edut; na pai' dhuuk gu Miktam gu Dabii na ba' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Aram-naaraim bhaan gu Aram gu Soba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab tu' naaka'n gu Edom gu Salinas mambhɨɨx gɨ'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; na gu' jix duñia' na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu'x; gio ba' i'i suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jix maa tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'r; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
Na ba' na ba' namkidhat tɨɨdam dodhia' bɨɨx kɨɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Sikêm gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' gu Miio gu Galaad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Epraim gu kavɨk mo'o; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Moab gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan gu Edom; mi' dhɨr gu vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Palestina.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham chɨkka bɨɨx ka'm gu Idumea.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bhaamki'ñdha' tulhiiñdha' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñchuda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Neginot; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' soi'm.
Na pai' dhuuk dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' duuñ tu' na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jodai kavɨk tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'ñbak gu kavɨk vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook iiñat.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu maa'nkar gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jedutuun; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' cham jix jai'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Perekereeis bɨx na ja'p mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin gu' jix duñia' ba'k; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' nɨɨra.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk tu' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu chio'ñ; gio ba' bɨx ka't gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gook mui'kim naak dhi'; na gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jurtu'nka' tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii kua' oidha' jix gaki gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu xibh; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ juraa'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' cham gu suudai'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gɇ'kamtu'nda' na ja'p tu' tu jiim xidhuu.
Na gu' na gu' tutkɨ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhai' aa' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bɨɨx tu' gu chin.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhim na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu tukaa'.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ɨkgiga'n.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' kɨɨ'n tu'.
Gu' gu' na ba' chajaañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii; gio ba' ka't.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't no'x; na gu' gu chin tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook soi'm; jano' ba' jix nukadham gu oidha' ɨɨbhi'ñ bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨxchuixim; gio ba' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai'; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' xoi'kam; gio ba' maa'n na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ jix dhaam suudai'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bhai'x ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ñiiñio'k; gio ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chichio'ñ tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr bhai' ñi'ook gu Dabii; jano' ba' tu' bhai' ñi'ook gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm; gio ba' tu' ɨlhdham bɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' daam; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' uañi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' duduaka' xoi'kam gu vaak jix bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x bɨx bhai' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' nɨɨra bɨx gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk bɨɨx bɨxchu'x gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam chɨbɨɨp.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' kɨɨ'p; gio ba' tu' gu xibh gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨɨx gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Jawatan Dios jix bhuup gu suudai'; na pai' dhuuk kai'ñ na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' na jix uam oidha' tas xoi'kam; gio ba' tɨbaa'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kai'ñ; gio ba' gu Dan jiiñak.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhai' ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi gu Por jix gɨ' gu kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki; gio ba' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu kavɨk na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu vupui bhaan chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr cham ka't; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' cham gu i'ii'ñ tɨɨt.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨgɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o; gio ba' ba'k gu tai gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ba'k gu vaak bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' tu' namkidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chin na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' ka't.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan kai' vaas tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaakax gu ñi'ook ɨ'ɨɨr; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨɨx nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan cham.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix kai gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham soi'm tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Neginot; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui bhaan no'ch gu Sela.
Na ba' na ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp; na gu' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' bhai' ñi'ookdha'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' maa'n gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' na ja'p u'u kavɨk kuubh u'u kavɨk; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' jir bhai' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu Ja gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' vupui bhaan.
