Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu vupui gu ɨ'ɨr tu duukam ka't.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ui'ka'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baaso kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨɨx tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Sosannim gu Edut; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asap; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Pastor gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' na ja'p kakneer gu Josee tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Epraim gu Benjamiin gu Manasees dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui duduaka'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan soi'm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu takarui' suakɨt i'i suakɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui duduaka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' jix bhuup gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨkgiga'n; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' bhai' jix duñia' bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' kavɨk gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano'; gio ba' dɨr gu tɨkɨr dhi' oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu vaas jix dhaas kɨɨ'n gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' vaak na jix bhaan gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't gu novɨ bhaan gu chio'ñ kɨɨ'n bhaan gu mar gu chio'ñ na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu oidha' maa'n tu' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vupui gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vupui duduaka'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Gittit; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asap; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu masad gu tanoolh nɨi'ñchudat gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' ñi'ook kavɨk gu Israeel jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chuut gu Josee tu' na pai' dhuuk jix buus gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na pai' tu' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu noobh bhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duuñ tu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook ɨxchuixim; mi' dhɨr tu' bhaan gu suudai' gu Meriba; jano' ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu'; gio ba' gu Israeel tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu chin.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam cham jix kai gu ñi'ook tu' gu Israeel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu ja'tkam tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tiriik; gio ba' suudai' na jix bhai' gu jodai tu' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asap; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu masad gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Depended gampai' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu novɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu tukgam; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ma'nkam bɨx gu Altiisimo.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chichio'ñ koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p no'x.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Asap; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham duiñ; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' mo'o.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam cham ka't chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ga'n gu Idumeos gu Ismaelitas gu Moab gu Agarenos.
Jano' ba' gu Gebal gu Ammoon gu Amalek; gio ba' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tiro.
Jano' ba' gio gu Assur tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Lot; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim na ja'p gu Madiaan; gio ba' na ja'p gu Siisara na ja'p gu Jabiin jix duu gu Kisoon.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Endor jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Oreb na ja'p gu Seeb; gio ba' na ja'p gu Seba na ja'p gu Salmunna bɨx chiñia'.
Na jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' no'ch gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p jajar vupui bhaan gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk na ja'p mɨmɨim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xi'ɨraam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Altiisimo bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu Gittit; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bakia' gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ba' pai' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chio'ñ juraa'n gu kavɨk tu'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baka suudai' buusñi na pai' dhuuk dhuuk gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk chulhiiñdha' gu vupui Xoi'kam.
Na gu' na gu' tutkɨ gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gɨ' mai'; gio ba' va'k gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tas kutun kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' nɨidhidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' tu' daak i'iich.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu vupui gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix bhai'x bhaan no'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak.
Jano' ba' cham jix maat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ja'tkam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam jɨɨgi'ñdham na ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mia'n tulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' jix duñia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx bhai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu'r gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨx bhai' dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gio xoi'kam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' maa'n gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' soi'm gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' jix nukadham gu i'ii'ñ na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dodhia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ tu duukam; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios soi'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mɨmɨim; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajim vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' kɨɨ'p; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' tu'r; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu Tema gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na gu' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix gɨ' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix dhaam suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup bhaan tu' jix kavɨk tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' jix dhaas vupui bhaan.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' daak jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'; gio ba' jix maa gu kavɨk tu duukam jix nukadham gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat na ba' xoi'kam ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios kiki'ñgob gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook tu' kiicham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' maaxir; mi' dhɨr gu Altiisimo.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi'; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx suudai' buusñi no'm tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koree; mi' dhɨr gu Muusiko gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na ba' bhaan gu Maalat; gio ba' gu Maskuil gu emaan gu Esraita; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ soi'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' naak tu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' mia'n tukga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na ja'p gu chio'ñ cham gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' cham.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam jix duñia' koko'kam na ba' gu Sela; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tukga'n xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r jai'chdhɨlhia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' bɨx bhai' gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' tu' duuñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu xibh soi'm tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baabuk gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na ja'p gu suudai' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duiñchu'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Maskuil gu Etaan gu Esraita; gio ba' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu'r bɨɨx gu chin.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook; na ba' bɨɨx tas ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr gu tɨkɨr tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Dabii tu duukam bham.
Na ba' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr.
